🎮 PlayStation Plus Game Catalog is getting even bigger!

Sony's November 2026 lineup keeps growing — on November 24, four more titles join Extra and Premium: Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii, Trepang2, MotoGP 26, and Cricket 26 – The Official Game of the Ashes.

They join games already live this month, including Death Stranding 2: On the Beach, Atomfall, Dragon Quest III HD-2D Remake, Hell Let Loose, and (Premium only) Soul Reaver 2 and Freedom Wars Remastered.

🕒 Posted 16:05 (GMT+3)

📰 Sources: Kotaku, Player.One
